xr_western_mass.description: Western Massachusetts chapter of Extinction Rebellion, a do-it-together climate movement, operating under the XR Boston network and running climate actions and vigils in the region.

mass_audubon_wma.description: Western Massachusetts arm of Mass Audubon, the statewide conservation nonprofit, which runs wildlife sanctuaries such as Pleasant Valley in Lenox, Canoe Meadows in Pittsfield and Lime Kiln Farm in Sheffield.

sunrise_lexington.description: Local hub of the Sunrise Movement in Lexington that pushes the town to declare a climate emergency, reach net-zero emissions and back a Green New Deal, with attention to impacts on communities of color.

environment_massachusetts.description: State advocacy group, part of the Environment America network, that uses research, public education, lobbying and litigation on global warming, clean energy, clean water and air, toxics, waste and conservation.

fore_river_residents_against_the_compres.description: Grassroots group of South Shore residents opposing the Enbridge natural gas compressor station beside the Fore River Bridge in North Weymouth, through public comment, legal appeals, demonstrations and resident education.

350ma.description: Statewide grassroots climate organization, a 501(c)(3) under Better Future Project, that works to end fossil fuel dependence through policy advocacy, direct action and organizing, via local chapters called nodes from the Berkshires to Cape Cod.

350ma_berkshires.description: Berkshire County node of 350 Mass, formed in 2014 to fight gas pipelines, now working to close fossil peaker plants, help towns with clean energy and Green Communities grants, and support legislative and environmental justice work.

climate_action_brookline.description: All-volunteer Brookline group that educates residents and property owners and advocates on buildings, transportation and electricity emissions to help the town reach its net zero goal.

jewish_alliance_for_law_and_social_actio.description: Membership-based Jewish social justice organization founded in 2001 that uses organizing, legislative advocacy, legal briefs and workshops; on climate it backs state legislation and belongs to the Mass Power Forward coalition.

arise_for_social_justice.description: Springfield group founded in 1985 by women on welfare that advocates for low-income people on housing, criminal justice and voting, and whose environmental justice committee fought the Palmer biomass incinerator and works on air pollution in the city.

bodhisara_dharma_community.description: Theravada Buddhist meditation community founded in 1996 in the Amherst and Northampton area, offering weekly classes, sitting groups and retreats.

climate_xchange.description: Boston-based nonprofit that provides research, education and advocacy tools on state climate policy and carbon pricing, and runs the State Climate Policy Network and Dashboard.

mass_audubon_wellfleet_bay_wildlife_sanc.description: Mass Audubon's 1,183-acre sanctuary in South Wellfleet on Cape Cod, protecting salt marsh, barrier beach and pine woodland habitat. It runs sea turtle rescue, diamondback terrapin and horseshoe crab protection, plus nature education, camps and trails.

pipeline_awareness_network_ne.description: Coalition working to prevent overbuilding of natural gas infrastructure; it hires attorneys and experts to intervene in FERC and state utility proceedings against pipeline expansions.

north_american_indian_center_of_boston.description: Nonprofit in Jamaica Plain serving Boston-area Native American communities with employment and training, family services, education and social services.

350ma_cape_cod.description: Cape Cod chapter (node) of 350 Mass, founded in 2017, a member-led local climate action group that meets in Hyannis.

berkshire_environmental_action_team.description: Pittsfield-based nonprofit protecting Berkshire County's environment through watchdogging of development and PCB contamination, river and habitat stewardship, and public education.

climate_code_blue.description: Massachusetts public-health and climate advocacy group that writes to officials and agencies opposing new fossil fuel plants, especially in environmental justice communities, and pushing emissions cuts.

partnership_for_policy_integrity.description: Pelham-based nonprofit that researches and advocates on energy policy, including opposing biomass and fossil gas and promoting renewables.

balanced_rock_investment_advisors.description: Roslindale financial advisory firm offering socially responsible investing, including fossil-fuel exclusions and local and impact investments in climate solutions, affordable housing and cooperatives.

elders_climate_action_mass.description: Massachusetts chapter of Elders Climate Action, a volunteer group of older adults who organize, educate and lobby for state climate legislation.

sunrise_boston.description: Boston hub of the Sunrise Movement, a youth-led group pushing for climate action and a just economy, including lobbying at the State House.

sunrise_amherst.description: Sunrise Movement hub in Amherst, started in 2019 by high school and college students, that runs climate strikes and outreach and backs a Green New Deal.

unitarian_universalist_mass_action.description: Statewide organizing and advocacy network of Massachusetts Unitarian Universalist congregations, with a climate and environmental justice campaign among its priorities.

coalition_for_social_justice.description: Grassroots organizing group founded in 1994 that does economic justice and anti-poverty advocacy through canvassing in low-income neighborhoods and legislative campaigns.
coalition_for_social_justice.geographic_focus: Southeastern Massachusetts (Brockton, Fall River, New Bedford)

slingshot.description: Environmental health and justice nonprofit that helps communities fight polluters, such as peaker plants, landfills, pipelines and PFAS contamination, across New England.

350ma_central_mass.description: All-volunteer Central Massachusetts affiliate of 350 Mass that opposes fossil fuel infrastructure, promotes electrification and works on environmental justice.

canton_residents_for_a_sustainable_equit.description: Volunteer group in Canton that promotes climate education and action, clean energy and environmental justice with regional partners.

food_and_water_watch.description: National advocacy group that campaigns against fossil fuel expansion; in Massachusetts it has pressed the governor to deny permits for the Enbridge pipeline expansion (Project Maple).

american_friends_service_committee_north.description: Northeast regional office of the Quaker peace and social justice organization AFSC, based in Cambridge.

ben_hillman_and_company.description: Creative studio in the Berkshires offering filmmaking, design, writing and illustration, including work for nonprofits.
